title: A Missed Delivery
instructions: Listen carefully. Choose the option that best matches what is said or implied.

audio.description: A voicemail offering a new delivery time.

transcript.text: Hi, I tried to deliver your parcel this afternoon, but nobody answered. I can come back between six and eight tomorrow evening. If that does not work, you can collect it from the depot after lunch on Friday. Please reply by text so I know which option to keep. It is too large for the letter slot.

questions.prompt: Why was the parcel not delivered?
questions.explanation: The caller says nobody answered when they tried to deliver the parcel.

questions.prompt: What is the alternative to another delivery?
options: Asking a neighbour to take it
questions.explanation: The caller offers collection from the depot after lunch on Friday.

questions.prompt: Why should the listener reply by text?
options: To choose which option to keep
To ask for a different parcel
To report the address as incorrect
questions.explanation: The driver needs to know which of the two options the listener prefers.
